hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$root" || exit 0; git ls-files -z --others --directory 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do case "$p" in docs/*|_freeze/*) : ;; *_files/) rm -rf -- "$p" ;; esac; done; git ls-files -z --others 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do case "$p" in docs/*|_freeze/*) : ;; *.quarto_ipynb*) rm -f -- "$p" ;; esac; done; exit 0
